Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.security

Class PraxisMetadataRequestMatchers

java.lang.Object
org.praxisplatform.uischema.security.PraxisMetadataRequestMatchers
public final class PraxisMetadataRequestMatchers extends Object
PathPatternParser-safe URL matchers for Praxis read-only POST endpoints (query filtering, cursor navigation, locate, analytical stats, collection export, and option-source lookups).

Spring Security 6.5's PathPatternParser rejects mid-path /**&#47; wildcards such as &#47;**&#47;filter. This helper emits explicit fixed-depth wildcard patterns (/api/*&#47;..., /api/*&#47;*&#47;..., /api/*&#47;*&#47;*&#47;...) so hosts can exempt read-only query POST routes from CSRF or distinguish read vs write authorization cleanly without ever sweeping in mutations, commands, or bulk confirmation/evaluation routes.
